title: 第2531章 诡异的幽影四位第2530章 姬玲珑妥协
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 他不再多言，右手随意一抛。
那半截散发着惊世锋芒的轩辕剑尖碎片，便化作一道流光，朝着姬玲珑飞去。
姬玲珑几乎是条件反射般地伸手接住，入手一片冰凉，但那冰冷的触感下，却仿佛能感受到沉睡万古的皇者脉搏与她血脉深处的共鸣！
她紧紧握住碎片，仿佛握住了姬氏一脉的未来，激动得手指都在微微颤抖。
身后的两位太上长老也难掩激动，目光死死盯着姬玲珑手中的碎片。
交易，达成。
古神族的命运改写了。
他古神族要站起来了。
姬玲珑指尖抚过轩辕剑尖碎片冰凉的断口，那沉睡万古的锋芒在她血脉深处激起无声的震颤，仿佛沉寂的火山即将喷薄。
她珍而重之地将其收起，掌心残留的刺痛感却远不及心头的惊涛骇浪。
她猛地抬头，锐利如鹰隼的目光扫过小院上空的幽影四卫，最终钉在方羽平静的脸上。
“先前那几位神王……”
姬玲珑的声音带着一丝不易察觉的干涩，每一个字都像在掂量。
“也是你的人吧！”
方羽迎着她的目光，没有丝毫闪躲。
既然幽影四卫已暴露，风云扬等人的存在自然无需再遮掩。
他坦然点头，动作干脆利落。
简单的承认，却如同惊雷炸响在寂静的小院。
姬玲珑纵然心中早有猜测，此刻亲眼见方羽点头，呼吸还是不由自主地一窒，绝美容颜上那强行维持的镇定，此时也不可抑制地产生波动。
六位惊才绝艳、战力逆天的神王！
四位深不可测、能无声潜入姬氏腹地的半步神皇巅峰影卫！
这股力量，足以在虚神界掀起滔天巨浪，甚至撼动一些古老传承的根基！
一旁的姜伊人，此时满是震惊。
她猛地转头看向方羽，那双清冷的眸子里充满了前所未有的陌生与惊疑。
眼前这个青年，眉眼依旧是熟悉的轮廓，气息深处也还是她所了解的爱徒吗？
可这份底蕴，这份翻手为云覆手为雨、连姬玲珑都被迫低头的掌控力……让她感到惊慌。
“你是我徒儿吗？”
姜伊人声音微颤，一步上前，玉手如电，瞬间扣住了方羽的手腕，半步神皇巅峰的神念毫无保留地、如同最精密的梳子般狠狠探入方羽体内，沿着经脉、丹田、识海、神魂本源疯狂扫视。
“你不会是被某个活了万载的老怪物夺舍了吧？！”
神念所及，经脉坚韧如龙筋，丹田浩瀚若星海，识海深处那株青莲虚影摇曳生姿，散发着纯粹而磅礴的生命本源气息。
神魂印记清晰无比，确凿无疑正是她熟悉的徒儿方羽！
没有任何被侵蚀、被替代的痕迹！
方羽无奈地任由师尊探查，苦笑道：
“师尊，别慌。我还是我，方牧。只是……得了些意想不到的机缘罢了。”
他轻轻拍了拍姜伊人紧绷的手背，带着安抚的暖意。
姜伊人缓缓收回神念，指尖的力道松懈下来，但眼中的惊疑与陌生并未完全褪去，反而沉淀为一种更深沉的困惑与审视。
她看着方羽，仿佛第一次真正认识这个弟子。
content_en:
He said no more and threw his right hand casually.
The tip fragment of the Xuanyuan Sword, which exuded a world-shattering edge, turned into a stream of light and flew towards Ji Linglong.
Ji Linglong reached out to catch it almost as a reflex, and her hands were cold, but under the cold touch, she seemed to be able to feel the pulse of the emperor who had been sleeping for eternity and the resonance deep in her blood!
She held the fragment tightly, as if she was holding the future of Ji's lineage, and her fingers were trembling slightly with excitement.
The two Supreme Elders behind him could not hide their excitement, their eyes fixed on the fragment in Ji Linglong's hand.
Deal, done.
The fate of the ancient gods has been rewritten.
The ancient gods are about to stand up.
Ji Linglong's fingertips touched the cold fracture of Xuanyuan Sword's tip, and the edge that had been sleeping for eternity stirred up a silent tremor deep in her blood, as if a silent volcano was about to erupt.
She put it away with great care, but the tingling sensation left in her palm was far less than the turbulent waves in her heart.
She raised her head suddenly, and her sharp hawk-like eyes swept across the four shadowy guards over the small courtyard, and finally nailed Fang Yu's calm face.
"Those god kings before..."
Ji Linglong's voice had an imperceptible dryness, and every word seemed to be weighed.
"He's yours too!"
Fang Yu met her gaze without evading it at all.
Now that the Four Shadow Guards have been exposed, there is no need to cover up the existence of Feng Yunyang and others.
He nodded calmly, his movements crisp and clear.
"Yes."
A simple admission was like thunder exploding in the silent courtyard.
Even though Ji Linglong had already guessed in her mind, seeing Fang Yu nodding with her own eyes, her breathing still involuntarily suffocated, and the composure she had forcibly maintained on her beautiful face could not help but fluctuate at this moment.
Six god-kings with stunning talents and incredible fighting prowess!
Four unfathomable half-step peak shadow guards of the God Emperor who can sneak into Ji's hinterland silently!
This power is enough to set off huge waves in the Virtual God Realm, and even shake the foundations of some ancient inheritances!
"You..."
Jiang Yiren on the side was full of shock at this time.
She suddenly turned her head to look at Fang Yu, her cold eyes filled with unprecedented strangeness and surprise.
The young man in front of her still had the familiar outline on his face, and was he still the beloved disciple she knew in his aura?
But this background, this control that could turn one hand into clouds or rain, even Ji Linglong was forced to bow her head... made her panic.
"Are you my disciple?"
Jiang Yiren's voice trembled slightly, and she stepped forward, her jade hands like lightning, and instantly grabbed Fang Yu's wrist. The half-step divine emperor's spiritual thoughts at the peak of the god penetrated Fang Yu's body without reservation, like the most precise comb, and scanned frantically along the meridians, dantian, sea of consciousness, and the origin of the soul.
"You weren't killed by some old monster who lived for thousands of years, were you?"
As far as the spiritual thoughts can reach, the meridians are as tough as dragon tendons, the dantian is as vast as the sea of stars, and the shadow of the green lotus in the depths of the sea of consciousness is swaying, exuding the pure and majestic breath of the origin of life.
The soul mark was extremely clear, and it was undoubtedly her familiar disciple Fang Yu!
There is no trace of erosion or replacement!
Fang Yu helplessly allowed his master to investigate, and said with a wry smile:
"Master, don't panic. I'm still me, Fang Mu. It's just... I got some unexpected opportunities."
He gently patted the back of Jiang Yiren's tense hand with a comforting warmth.
Jiang Yiren slowly withdrew her spiritual thoughts, and the strength of her fingertips relaxed, but the surprise and strangeness in her eyes did not completely fade away, but instead settled into a deeper confusion and scrutiny.
She looked at Fang Yu as if she really knew this disciple for the first time.
